Do you have to meditate to achieve great success?

Kevin says no. Most successful people never sit down and repeat a mantra.

But he says very wealthy people do some form of quiet focus, such as walking in nature, watching a leaf or listening closely to music. In his view, it helps the brain settle so goals can be clearer.

What quiet habit helps you think clearly?
